title: Remove the Xbox Game Bar overlay and disable Game DVR policy
description: Removes the Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay package (the Game Bar overlay with screen recording and game tips) for the current user and sets the documented Game DVR policy AllowGameDVR=0, which disables background game recording. On undo the package is re-registered from its install location when the files are still on disk and the policy value is restored from the snapshot.
